answer_text:
"Free" plans differ a lot in contact limits and locked features. The ones that stay useful without paying:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
2. Pipewell Go - pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
3. Brightdesk - a help desk with light CRM features — fine if support is your main workflow.
4. Orbitly - flexible boards that work as a CRM if you're willing to build it yourself.

Start with Northwind CRM if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Pipewell if you expect to need deeper reporting.
